title: Minisforum Unveils S5 and S7 All-Flash NAS Units with Intel Core Series 3 Processors
summary: （AI制限中のため原文） Minisforum and Intel held a joint launch event in Xiamen, introducing two new all-flash NAS systems ...
content:
※API制限のため原文を表示します

Minisforum and Intel held a joint launch event in Xiamen, introducing two new all-flash NAS systems built around Intel Series 3 processors, the compact S5 and the seven-bay S7. The S5 is the more distinctive of the two. It runs Intel Core Series 3 (Wildcat Lake), Intel's 18A-based platform for edge, laptops and commercial devices and adopts a no-HDDs approach featuring five M.2 2280 PCIe 4.0 x1 SSD slots. The fanless design combined with the all-SSD layout means it runs completely silent. Minisforum is even pitching it at home theater setups and anywhere noise is a concern. Memory goes up to 16 GB of LPDDR5X-7200, and connectivity includes a 10 GbE RJ45, a 2.5 GbE RJ45, two USB4 40 Gbps ports, two USB 3.2 Type-A ports, and HDMI 2.1. Wi-Fi 7 is also on board, and combined SSD throughput is rated at up to 10.8 GB/s. The S7 is built on the MS-03 workstation platform and steps up to seven NVMe slots for heavier storage workloads. Networking is more enterprise-oriented, with dual 10G SFP+ fiber ports, a 10G RJ45, a 2.5G RJ45, and two USB4 40 Gbps ports. An LED status display lets users check system and storage activity making it more suited to home-lab and power user setups. Both systems support Minisforum MinisOpenClaw AI agent, which includes features like AI semantic photo search and installs in one click. No pricing or release date has been announced.

title: A Closer Look at watchOS 26.5's New Luminance Watch Face

content:

With watchOS 26.5, Apple is introducing a Pride Luminance face, and it's one of the most versatile and customizable watch faces. There are pre-configured color options, but the face also supports custom colors. You can select 1 to 12 colors from a palette that has every color of the rainbow, some in-between shades, and black, white, brown, and gray. The colors you pick are distributed across the watch face in a gradient, available in either radial or linear styles. The first style looks like a starburst, while the second style is a series of rectangular lines. The dial can be set to Rectangle for edge-to-edge color, or Circle for a smaller dial that supports four complications. As with most of Apple's faces, the Luminance face is animated. When the wrist is down, it shrinks into slim lines of color on a black background, but when the wrist is raised, the full color palette is displayed. Colors will also shift slowly. Apple's pre-selected colors represent different Pride flag colors, but with the deep customization options, the Pride Luminance face can match clothing, show off support for sports teams, or just display your favorite colors. iOS 26.5 also has a matching Pride Luminance Wallpaper option that can be customized in the same way. You can choose up to 12 colors for the Lock Screen and Home Screen. On the Lock Screen, the colors collapse onto a black background when the device is locked. title: PlayStation 6 Price and Launch Date Remain Uncertain in Face of DRAM Pricing Uncertainty
summary: （AI制限中のため原文） Despite earlier rumors speculating about both the upcoming PlayStation 6's pricing and supposed laun...
content:
※API制限のため原文を表示します

Despite earlier rumors speculating about both the upcoming PlayStation 6's pricing and supposed launch date, it has come to light in a recent investor call that Sony has yet to actually decide on either of those aspects of the new console's launch. When asked about the progress of the next-gen console, Sony CEO, Hiroki Totoki, said that "Looking at the current circumstances, the memory price is also expected to be very high FY 2027, because there will still be a shortage of supply," going on to explain that "We have not yet decided on at what timing we will launch the new console or at what prices, so we would like to really observe and follow the situation." Sony isn't the only console maker struggling with pricing. The Xbox Helix is expected to launch at a price of around $1,000 when it eventually hits the market, and, while the rumor mill has nothing to say about Nintendo's next console launch this early in the Switch 2's lifecycle, there has been talk of a potential price increase for the Nintendo Switch 2—an issue worsened by softening US sales. The PS5 itself also recently saw a sizeable price increase, and although Sony didn't provide a justification for the price increases outside of "the global economic landscape," the assumption has largely been that increasing DRAM prices have been to blame for the price increase.

title: Warning: Instagram DMs Lose End-to-End Encryption Starting Today
summary: （AI制限中のため原文） As of today, end-to-end encryption for Instagram direct messages is no longer available. DMs that yo...
content:
※API制限のため原文を表示します

As of today, end-to-end encryption for Instagram direct messages is no longer available. DMs that you send to people on Instagram will no longer feature full encryption, and your conversations are not protected from Meta. Meta can potentially see what's in messages shared between users on Instagram, and that information can be shared with law enforcement agencies worldwide. End-to-end encryption has been an opt-in messaging feature on Instagram since 2023, but Meta quietly removed it. Meta told The Guardian earlier this year that it is removing the encryption feature because not enough people adopted it. At the same time, Meta did not turn it on by default, nor did the company alert users that it was an option. Sending an encrypted message required turning it on for each individual conversation by tapping into a buried per-conversation setting. Meta also never rolled the feature out to all Instagram users. "Very few people were opting in to end-to-end encrypted messaging in DMs, so we're removing this option from Instagram in the coming months," Meta said. Meta suggests that people who want end-to-end encryption should use WhatsApp, which is another messaging app that it owns. iMessage and other apps like Signal that are not Meta-owned also offer end-to-end encryption. title: Apple Seeds Second iOS 26.5 and iPadOS 26.5 Release Candidates to Developers
summary: （AI制限中のため原文） Apple today seeded new release candidate versions of upcoming iOS 26.5 and iPadOS 26.5 updates to de...
content:
※API制限のため原文を表示します

Apple today seeded new release candidate versions of upcoming iOS 26.5 and iPadOS 26.5 updates to developers for testing purposes, with the software coming five days after the first RC. It's not clear what's changed in the second RC, but Apple typically sends out another candidate if there are bugs that need to be addressed. Registered developers can download the betas from the Settings app on the iPhone or iPad by going to the General section and selecting Software Update. iOS 26.5 and iPadOS 26.5 do not include new Siri capabilities, suggesting any ‌Siri‌ updates are being held until iOS 27. The Maps app has a Suggested Places feature for recommending locations to visit nearby based on trends and recent searches, plus Apple is laying the groundwork for ads in the Apple Maps app. Apple is continuing to test end-to-end encryption (E2EE) for RCS messages between iPhone and Android users. Apple included the feature in the iOS 26.4 beta, but removed it before the update launched to the public. There is a new Pride wallpaper to go along with the Pride Apple Watch band for this year. More detail on what's new in iOS 26.5 can be found in our iOS 26.5 beta features guide. iOS 26.5 is likely to see a launch next week. title: Apple Could Soon Be Buying iPhone and Mac Chips From Old Frenemy Intel
summary: （AI制限中のため原文） After more than a year of discussion, Apple and Intel established a preliminary agreement that will ...
content:
※API制限のため原文を表示します

After more than a year of discussion, Apple and Intel established a preliminary agreement that will see Intel manufacturing processors for Apple devices, reports The Wall Street Journal. Intel would make chips based on Apple chip designs, much like TSMC. Prior rumors on Intel's Apple talks have suggested Intel could make some of the lower-end processors used in Apple devices, including the lowest-end M-series chip used in select iPad and Mac models. Before Apple adopted Apple silicon, it used Intel-designed chips for its Macs, but had to deal with continual chip delays. Apple now designs its own Arm chips that are manufactured by TSMC, allowing it to provide updates at a more regular cadence. Intel makes its own chips, but it also makes chips for other companies. Apple has not previously eyed Intel as a supplier because it has lagged behind other chip makers like TSMC and Samsung, and because of the history between the two companies. Intel replaced CEO Pat Gelsinger with Lip-Bu Tan last year, and Tan has led an effort to revitalize Intel's chip manufacturing business. Tan has been focusing on Intel's most advanced process node, 14A, which will reach production in 2028. Intel has been seeking customers for its 14A 1.4nm node. title: 【翻訳失敗】TSMC and Sony Team Up on Next-Gen Image Sensor and New Production Lines for AI
summary: AI生成失敗
content: Sony Semiconductor Solutions and TSMC have signed a non-binding memorandum of understanding to form a joint venture focused on next-generation image sensor development and manufacturing. Sony will be the majority and controlling shareholder in the joint venture, which plans to set up development and production lines at Sony's newly built fab in Koshi City, Kumamoto Prefecture. The partnership brings together Sony's image sensor design expertise and TSMC's process technology and manufacturing scale. Beyond conventional imaging, the two companies are also looking at opportunities in physical AI applications, automotive and robotics specifically, where high-performance sensing is becoming increasingly important. Investment plans for the joint venture are still being worked out, and Sony is also considering additional capital investment in its existing Nagasaki plant. Both are being planned in phases based on market demand and are contingent on Japanese government support. Earlier reporting from Reuters indicated Japan's Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI) has confirmed subsidies of up to ¥60 billion (around $380 million) for Sony's Kumamoto image sensor facility. The timing makes sense for both sides. TSMC is already involved in Kumamoto through its first fab there, which entered mass production in late 2024 supplying Sony Semiconductor Solutions and DENSO on 22/28 nm and 12/16 nm nodes. The new joint venture would push that relationship into more advanced territory. For Sony, the move comes as competitive pressure in the image sensor market is building as Samsung has been gaining ground in supplying sensors for Apple, squeezing Sony's position in a segment it has long dominated. However, the joint venture still needs a definitive legally binding agreement before it's official.

title: Apple Taps TSMC For Fresh A18 Pro Silicon To Double MacBook Neo Production
summary: （AI制限中のため原文） It's no secret that Apple's $599 MacBook Neo has been a hit for general productivity workflows and a...
content:

It's no secret that Apple's $599 MacBook Neo has been a hit for general productivity workflows and as a Chromebook replacement, but in a recent financial results report, Tim Cook touched on just how unexpectedly high the Neo's demand was. The outgoing CEO on April 30 confirmed that Apple was supply-constrained on the MacBook Neo, explaining that "we under-called the level of enthusiasm that would be with it." In a recent report, industry analyst, Tim Culpan claimed that insider sources report that Apple has ordered a fresh production run on the A18 Pro SoC that powers the MacBook Neo from TSMC. Crucially, getting TSMC to spin up a new production run of the A18 Pro may affect the pricing of the Neo, since its initial production run used rejected A18 Pro SoCs—with a defective GPU core—from the original iPhone 16 Pro smartphones, and a new run of SoCs would mean that Apple would be subject to the same memory supply constraints as the rest of the industry instead of using up old inventory that had already been paid for at a lower price. This news also comes after wild rumors of a potentially incoming MacBook Neo with an A19 Pro from the newer iPhone 17 Pro, replete with a potential 12 GB RAM upgrade. The fresh SoCs from TSMC, however, would allow Apple to reach its new 10 million unit production goal without changing anything about the hardware itself.

When Valve launched the Steam Controller, the new gaming peripheral expectedly sold out within the first day of sales. Valve then promised stock was coming soon, stating that the demand for the controller was unexpected. Now, the gaming giant has confirmed that changes are coming to the Steam Controller ordering process in order to mitigate the high demand and limited supply. Starting on May 8 at 10:00 Pacific time (17:00 UTC), Valve will allow users to place a reservation for the Steam Controller on the usual store page, which will allow prospective buyers to reserve a spot in the queue. When the controller is back in stock, Valve will automatically place orders for reservation holders in the order they placed their reservations, and buyers will have 72 hours from the time they receive that order email to finalize their purchase through Steam. Notably, Valve is restricting reservations to one controller per account, and those who have already purchased a Steam Controller will not be able to place reservations until further notice. It's also worth pointing out that Valve has added additional account conditions in order to prevent scalping. Steam accounts seeking to place a reservation will need to be in good standing and have made a purchase before April 27, 2026. Valve also confirmed that the US, Canada, the UK, EU, and Australia will be getting Steam Controller restocks next week—meaning May 11.

content: Apple's upcoming camera-equipped AirPods Pro are nearing completion and have reached an "advanced" testing stage, reports Bloomberg. The design is almost finalized, as is the feature set, and early mass production could begin soon. The AirPods Pro will have built-in cameras that will feed visual information about the wearer's surroundings to Siri. While there will be a longer stem for the camera in each AirPod, the device will otherwise look similar to the AirPods Pro 3. The cameras in the AirPods will not be able to take photos or videos, and will solely be used for AI purposes. A small LED light will illuminate when the AirPods are sending visual information to ‌Siri‌. Apple wants users to be able to look at an item and ask ‌Siri‌ questions about it, working similarly to image uploads in chatbot apps. The cameras could also offer reminders based on visual information, and give more detailed turn-by-turn directions by viewing what's around the wearer. The Camera app in iOS 27 is also set to get a Siri mode that incorporates Visual Intelligence, letting users do things like scan nutrition labels on food packaging for calorie tracking. Apple wanted to start selling the camera-equipped AirPods Pro in the first half of 2026, but the product's launch has been held back because the smarter, AI version of ‌Siri‌ is not yet ready to be released. The new ‌Siri‌ is set to be introduced in September in ‌iOS 27‌, macOS 27, and iPadOS 27, so we could see the AirPods Pro launch sometime in that same timeframe. Apple could also opt to wait to launch the AirPods if it is not satisfied with the quality of the ‌Visual Intelligence‌ features planned for ‌Siri‌. It is not yet clear how the new AirPods will fit into Apple's lineup. Rave, a cross-platform service that lets users watch movies and TV shows together, today filed a series of antitrust lawsuits against Apple after Apple removed the Rave app from the App Store in August 2025. According to Rave, Apple cited "unspecified allegations of fraud and vague concerns about content moderation" when pulling the app. Rave alleges Apple targeted the service because Rave competed with SharePlay, and Apple wanted to corner the market on smartphone co-viewing. Rave claims that Apple also falsely labeled the Rave Mac app as malware, preventing Mac users from installing it. Discussion on Reddit suggests that Rave had unmoderated public chatrooms, pornography, issues with scams, and CSAM material. The Rave app was also labeled as malware by Kaspersky, BitDefender, Windows, and Google, suggesting Apple may have had reason to protect users from the app beyond limiting competition. Apple has not yet commented on the lawsuit or the app's removal. Rave claims that it has now created "industry-leading" content moderation and age verification technologies, presumably to preempt Apple's content moderation criticism. Rave was available on iOS, Mac, Android, and Windows, but after Apple's crackdown, the service is limited to Windows and Android devices. Founded in 2016, Rave lets users remotely watch content together, with built-in discussion features. Reportedly, this feature boosts the CPU to its maximum frequency for 1-3 seconds, resulting in noticeably smoother app launches during testing. When launching Microsoft applications like Edge and Outlook, known as "in-box" apps, the result is about a 40% faster application launch. Other applications, such as the Start Menu and context menus across the operating system, may be up to 70% faster. Overall, the Windows 11 operating system is expected to receive a significant performance boost, though at the cost of the CPU reaching its maximum frequency. Currently, this feature within the Windows K2 effort is automatic, with no clear indication if it can be turned on or off. Running a CPU at its maximum frequency is somewhat unusual, as the purpose of an operating system is to minimize strain on the PC, leaving headroom for heavier applications to load. However, since the boost is only applied in short bursts of up to three seconds, it is expected that the performance benefits and overall smoothness will outweigh potential issues. These issues include elevated CPU frequency during lighter tasks and general OS usage, which could result in slightly higher temperatures overall. For laptop users, this might lead to faster battery drain, but it is likely that the Windows K2 effort will account for this, with minimal impact. Read full story

title: 【翻訳失敗】PC Motherboard Sales Face Sharp 25%+ Decline Amid Weak Demand
summary: AI生成失敗
content: PC motherboard sales are on track for some of the biggest corrections in recent times as manufacturers struggle with weak demand, according to a DigiTimes report. What began as AI data center expansion quickly started affecting consumer PC DIY endeavors, as severe silicon shortages across the industry drove DRAM and CPU demand so high that prices have increased significantly for DDR4 and DDR5 memory kits, while regular CPUs have also seen a large price increase. In response, PC motherboard makers are caught in the middle of this shortage, seeing their motherboard unit sales revised down significantly. The report notes that all Taiwanese motherboard makers have significantly lowered their 2026 shipment targets, with some experiencing more than a 25% decrease in projected unit sales. Interestingly, it's not only CPU and memory shortages driving this lowered demand; there are indications that consumers have slowed down their NVIDIA GPU upgrade cycles, which is impacting new motherboard sales. Particularly with the "Blackwell" GPU generation, consumers began purchasing PCIe 5.0 motherboards to achieve the greatest performance increase. However, as these GPUs became rarer and more expensive due to the global DRAM shortage, consumers have become reluctant to upgrade. ASUS is projected to sell about 10 million motherboards in 2026, while MSI and GIGABYTE are now projecting sales of less than 10 million units each. This represents about a 25% yearly decrease from 2025 sales. The worst position is estimated for ASRock, which is expected to see a 30% decrease according to the report. Read full story

Apple has agreed to pay $250 million to settle a U.S. class action lawsuit over delayed Siri features, and eligible iPhone users could receive up to a $95 payout. Below, we have answered some key questions regarding the lawsuit. Why Was Apple Sued? In June 2024, Apple previewed new Siri capabilities powered by Apple Intelligence, including understanding of a user's personal context, on-screen awareness, and deeper per-app controls. For example, Apple showed an iPhone user asking Siri about their mother's flight and lunch reservation plans based on info from the Mail and Messages apps. Apple advertised those Siri features in product presentations, on its website, in a TV commercial starring actor Bella Ramsey, and elsewhere. In March 2025, Apple delayed the launch of the personalized version of Siri, leading to the company being hit with a class action lawsuit alleging false advertising. In a statement, Apple touted a range of other Apple Intelligence features it has already released. Nevertheless, Apple agreed to settle the lawsuit "to stay focused" on "delivering the most innovative products and services to our users." Am I Eligible? To be eligible to submit a claim, you must reside in the U.S. and have purchased any iPhone 15 Pro or iPhone 16 model between June 10, 2024 and March 29, 2025. The Satechi DotDisk comes in silver and Space Black and is available now at satechi.com for $199.99. No SSD is included.

title: 【翻訳失敗】PCIe 8.0 Targets 1 TB/s Bandwidth and May Need a New Connector
summary: AI生成失敗
content: PCI-SIG has released a small update on its upcoming PCIe 8.0 standard, with the draft milestone reaching version 0.5. Perhaps the most intriguing aspect of this draft update is not the performance itself, but the exploration of a new connector technology to support this high-bandwidth protocol. Last year, we learned that PCI-SIG plans to implement a 256.0 GT/s raw bit rate and 1 TB/s of bidirectional bandwidth in the x16 lane configuration. We had assumed that the protocol would continue using the familiar connector technology seen in previous PCIe updates. However, it turns out that the current connector might be a limiting factor, prompting the search for a replacement for the traditional PCIe electrical connection. The traditional PCIe connector is a copper-based link with up to 16 lanes connecting graphics cards to a slot. In a full x16 lane configuration, the PCIe generation supported by the motherboard provides the best performance, offering the maximum bandwidth the platform can deliver. However, with a 256 GT/s raw bit rate, the connector provides about 1 TB/s of bidirectional bandwidth, which is five times faster than the current PCIe 5.0 platform used with modern GPUs and CPUs. This indicates that the current physical layer facilitating communication between a GPU and a motherboard is nearing saturation with the advent of PCIe 8.0, necessitating the consideration of an alternative connection method. title: 【翻訳失敗】Google Chrome Silently Downloads 4 GB AI Model on Your PC Without Consent
summary: AI生成失敗
content: Google Chrome is reportedly downloading a 4 GB AI model onto user PCs without consent, prior information, or any way for less technical users to discover it independently. According to Alexander Hanff, who publishes a blog called "That Privacy Guy," Google Chrome is installing a 4 GB Gemini Nano model locally without user consent. The researcher discovered that Google Chrome downloads and installs the local AI model automatically, without any user input. Google Chrome initiates this process by creating an "OptGuideOnDeviceModel" folder, which contains a "weights.bin" file that is exactly 4 GB. This file is used for Google's Gemini Nano model, which handles on-device scam detection, AI-assisted writing, and other tasks. The entire process takes about 15 minutes to complete, all without the user's knowledge. Why does this happen? Google Chrome automatically scans your device to assess whether it can run local AI models and only triggers the download when AI features are active. There is no specific checkbox in the browser settings indicating a 4 GB local AI model download. Interestingly, users who deleted this 4 GB model found that Google Chrome redownloaded it repeatedly, continuing the cycle. The only way to prevent or disable the download is by disabling Chrome's AI features through the "chrome://flags" settings, using enterprise policy settings in your organization, or simply uninstalling Chrome to stop the automatic downloads. Omarchy 3.7 is out, and gaming is the headline feature. The Arch-based distro led by David Heinemeier Hansson has rolled out what it's calling a Gaming Edition update, overhauling Linux gaming support across the board. Steam now installs automatically without any user input and drops the problematic SDL_VIDEODRIVER environment variable that was causing compatibility issues with many games. Beyond emulation, Omarchy 3.7 adds launchers for Lutris (Battle.net games like Diablo, StarCraft, and WoW), Heroic (Epic Games titles without anti-cheat, so no Fortnite or Rocket League), and Moonlight for streaming games from a Windows PC running Sunshine. An Xbox Cloud Gaming web app rounds out the gaming additions, covering Game Pass titles including ones that won't run natively on Linux. Outside of gaming, the update introduces a new unified omarchy command that replaces the previous scattered omarchy-* commands, with tab completion and a cleaner interface for installing software, taking screenshots, and analyzing issues. Elon Musk recently announced an ambitious project called Terafab, which he plans to build on Tesla's campus in eastern Travis County, Austin, Texas. Thanks to recent court hearings in Grimes County, Texas, we have learned that the first phase of the Terafab project is expected to cost $55 billion. However, if additional phases are constructed, this figure could rise to $119 billion. While this is an astonishingly high amount, it seems justified given Terafab's ambitious goals. Semiconductor manufacturing is one of the greatest marvels of the modern world, with only a few companies competing for the top spot. The engineering and scientific expertise required for building modern semiconductor manufacturing facilities is so rare that it is concentrated in just a few places around the globe. The goal of Terafab is to consolidate the entire chip manufacturing process under one roof. The plant is expected to integrate several stages of semiconductor production at a single site, including logic fabrication, memory, packaging, testing, and mask production. This setup is unusual, as these steps are typically spread across multiple specialized facilities and companies. The idea behind Terafab is that consolidating these processes could accelerate development by allowing engineers to design, test, and revise chips with fewer delays, essentially enabling rapid prototyping. Apple's iPhone 17 was the best-selling smartphone globally in the first quarter of 2026, capturing 6 percent of worldwide unit sales, according to Counterpoint Research's latest Global Handset Model Sales Tracker. The iPhone 17 series dominated the top three spots, with the iPhone 17 Pro Max in second place and the iPhone 17 Pro in third. The previous-generation iPhone 16 also held on at sixth place, suggesting there's still strong demand for the model, following its blockbuster sales run throughout last year. Not only did the iPhone 17 post double-digit year-over-year growth in China and the U.S., it also tripled its sales in South Korea for the quarter. Samsung's Galaxy A series filled the remaining five spots, led by the budget-friendly Galaxy A07 4G as the best-selling Android phone of the quarter. Xiaomi's Redmi A5 filled out the list in tenth place. Taken together, the top 10 devices accounted for 25% of global smartphone sales -- the highest first-quarter concentration ever recorded, according to Counterpoint. title: Apple、メリーランド州のユニオン化店舗閉鎖で議員から圧力を受ける
summary:
• メリーランド州の議員9名が、AppleによるTowson Town Center店の閉鎖決定について、Tim Cook CEOとJohn Ternus氏に懸念を表明した。
• Towson Town Center店は2022年にApple初のユニオン化店舗となり、IAM COREと2024年に団体協約を締結していた。
• Appleは、Towson Town Center店を含む3店舗の閉鎖理由として、ショッピングモールの小売業者離れと状況悪化を挙げている。
content:
メリーランド州議会の議員9名が、AppleのTowson Town Center店の閉鎖決定に関して、Tim Cook CEOとJohn Ternus氏に対し、強い懸念を表明した。議員らは、6月20日に閉鎖される予定の同店に対し、代替店舗の開設がないまま閉鎖されることについて、地域経済への影響を懸念している。

議員らは、Towson Town Center店が「好調な店舗」であったと認識している一方、Tommy Bahama、Banana Republic、Madewellなどの主要小売店が既に撤退するなど、ショッピングモール全体の状況は悪化していると指摘されている。閉鎖により、約90人の従業員が影響を受けると見込まれており、議員らはAppleに対し、今回の決定の根拠や、移転などの代替案の検討状況について、より詳細な説明を求めている。

Appleは先月、Towson Town Center店に加え、コネチカット州TrumbullのApple Trumbull、カリフォルニア州EscondidoのApple North Countyの3店舗を6月に永久閉鎖すると発表した。Appleは、これらの店舗の閉鎖理由として、小売業者の離脱とショッピングモールの状況悪化を挙げている。Trumbull店とNorth County店の従業員は、近隣の店舗への転勤が保証されている。一方、Towson Town Center店の従業員は、団体協約に基づき、Apple内の空席に応募できるが、全員が新たなポジションを確保できるとは限らない。

Towson Town Center店は、2022年にApple初のユニオン化店舗となり、International Association of Machinists and Aerospace Workers' Coalition of Organized Retail Employees (IAM CORE)に所属している。IAM COREは、先月、National Labor Relations Boardに対し、Appleに対する不当労働慣行の申し立てを行っている。

中の人の本音 (JP)

うーん、Appleも色々大変なんだろうけどさ。ユニオンできたお店を閉めるって、ちょっと見方によっちゃ微妙じゃない？従業員のことも考えれば、転勤とかもっとスムーズにできるはずなんだけどな。様子見安定。
review_en: Hmm, Apple has its own issues, but closing a unionized store is kinda sus. They should make transfers smoother for employees.
title_en: Maryland Lawmakers Press Apple Over Unionized Store Closure
summary_en:
• Nine Maryland lawmakers expressed serious concern to Apple's Tim Cook and John Ternus regarding the closure of the Towson Town Center store.
• The Towson Town Center store became Apple's first unionized retail location in 2022, signing a collective bargaining agreement with IAM CORE in 2024.
• Apple cited retailer departures and declining conditions at the shopping malls as reasons for closing three stores, including Towson Town Center.
content_en:
Nine members of the Maryland legislature have expressed serious concern to Apple CEO Tim Cook and hardware engineering chief John Ternus regarding the company's decision to close the Towson Town Center store. The lawmakers are concerned about the impact on the local economy, as the store is scheduled to close on June 20th without plans for a replacement location.

Lawmakers recognize that the Towson Town Center store has been a "strong-performing location," but note that the shopping mall is in decline, with major retailers such as Tommy Bahama, Banana Republic, and Madewell already having departed. The closure is expected to affect approximately 90 employees, and lawmakers have asked Apple for a more detailed explanation of the rationale behind the decision and whether alternatives, such as relocation, were meaningfully considered.

Last month, Apple announced that it would permanently close three retail stores in June, including the Towson Town Center store, Apple Trumbull in Trumbull, Connecticut, and Apple North County in Escondido, California. Apple cited retailer departures and declining conditions at the shopping malls as reasons for the closures. Employees at the Trumbull and North County stores are guaranteed transfers to nearby stores. Employees at the Towson Town Center store are eligible to apply for open positions within Apple, in accordance with their collective bargaining agreement, but it is unclear if everyone who applies will secure a new position.

The Towson Town Center store became Apple's first unionized retail location in the U.S. in 2022, belonging to the International Association of Machinists and Aerospace Workers' Coalition of Organized Retail Employees (IAM CORE). Last month, the IAM union filed an unfair labor practice charge with the National Labor Relations Board (NLRB).

Review (EN)

Hmm, Apple has its own issues, but closing a unionized store is kinda sus. They should make transfers smoother for employees.

The bugs were in the Messages and Workout apps. In Messages, an issue where the app may use SMS instead of iMessage when paired with a dual SIM iPhone has been fixed. In Workout, an issue where audio alerts could fail to play if the phone was not nearby Apple Watch has been fixed.

The notes also mention the new Pride Luminance watch face available on watchOS 26.5, which has a customizable layout and colors. Given that the watchOS 26.5 Release Candidate was seeded this week, Apple is likely to make the update available to all users next week.

title: iPhone 18、仕様見直しと発売時期変更の可能性が浮上
summary:
• iPhone 18とiPhone 18eで部品の共通化が進むとリーク情報で示唆されている。
• iPhone 18の仕様が下方修正され、発売時期が2027年春に遅れる可能性がある。
• iPhone 18 Pro、iPhone 18 Pro Max、そして折りたたみ型「iPhone Ultra」は従来通り秋に発表される見込み。
content:
リーカー「Fixed Focus Digital」の情報によると、標準モデルのiPhone 18と廉価版のiPhone 18eで部品が共通化される可能性があることが明らかになった。これは、Appleが両機種間の格差を縮小させる動きの表れと見られている。

Fixed Focus DigitalはWeiboへの投稿で、特定の部品が両モデル間で互換性を持つことを指摘し、この情報は信頼できる製造元からのものであると述べている。リーカーは、この部品の共通化を、iPhone 18とiPhone 18eの仕様収束がサプライチェーンレベルで現実のものとなっていることの証拠だと説明している。

さらに、「標準モデルのiPhone 18は仕様が下方修正され、発売が遅れるという決定は最終的なものであり、変更はない」と付け加えた。もしiPhone 18が2027年春に発売される場合、9月と10月はiPhone 18 Pro、iPhone 18 Pro Max、そして折りたたみ型「iPhone Ultra」にとっての「フラッグシップシーズン」となるだろうと示唆されている。

Proモデルと標準モデルの発売時期を分ける戦略は、昨年から広く報道されており、Ming-Chi KuoやNikkeiもこの計画を裏付けている。部品の共通化に関する主張は、ここ2週間で相次いでいる仕様変更の報告に続くものだ。リーカーは以前、Appleがコスト削減策としてiPhone 18に特定の製造上の変更を加えることを報告し、その後、ディスプレイ仕様とチップも影響を受けると付け加えた。Appleは、デバイスで使用されるAシリーズチップの名前を調整することで、チップの変更の程度を曖昧にしようとしている可能性がある。

iPhone 18とiPhone 18eのエンジニアリング検証テストは、両デバイスが現在、重要なエンジニアリングの重複を共有しているという考えと一致して、6月に同時に行われているという。一方、iPhone 17とiPhone 17eは明確な違いがある。iPhone 17は6.3インチのProMotionディスプレイ、最大3,000ニッツのピーク輝度、Dynamic Island、5コアGPU、超広角カメラ、そして優れたバッテリー寿命を特徴とする。iPhone 17eは、より小型の6.1インチディスプレイ、Dynamic Islandの代わりにノッチ、ProMotionの欠如、4コアGPU、そして超広角カメラを持たない。

AppleがiPhone 18とiPhone 18eの間で部品を共有し、標準モデルのディスプレイとチップの仕様を削減する場合、これらの違いの多くは次世代で縮小または完全に消滅する可能性がある。iPhone 18、iPhone 18e、そしてiPhone Air 2はすべて2027年春に発売されると予想されており、iPhone 18 Pro、iPhone 18 Pro Max、そしてiPhone Ultraは秋に発表される見込みである。

中の人の本音 (JP)

え、マジでiPhone 18スペックダウンするの？コストカットとか言ってるけど、正直ちょっと萎える。Proモデルと標準モデルの差が小さくなるのは良いけど、性能が落ちるなら困るなぁ。様子見安定かな。春にまた新しいiPhone出るってのも変な感じだし。
review_en: Wait, is iPhone 18 really getting downgraded? Cost-cutting is fine, but honestly, it's a bit disappointing.
title_en: iPhone 18 Downgrades and Delayed Launch Rumored
summary_en:
• Component sharing between the iPhone 18 and iPhone 18e is suggested by a leak.
• The iPhone 18 may face specification downgrades and a launch delay to spring 2027.
• The iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max, and foldable 'iPhone Ultra' are still expected in the fall.
content_en:
According to leaker "Fixed Focus Digital," the standard iPhone 18 and the lower-cost iPhone 18e may share components, suggesting Apple is narrowing the gap between the two models.

In posts on Weibo, Fixed Focus Digital noted that certain parts are interchangeable between the two models, stating that the information comes from a reliable manufacturing source. The leaker described the component overlap as confirmation that the specification convergence between the iPhone 18 and iPhone 18e is real and measurable at the supply chain level.

They added, "Take it from me: The standard iPhone 18 model has been downgraded and its launch delayed-this decision is final and will not change." If the iPhone 18 ships in spring 2027 rather than alongside the Pro models in the fall, September and October will effectively become "flagship season" for Apple, a window occupied by the iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max, and the foldable "iPhone Ultra."

A split launch strategy separating the Pro and standard models has been widely reported since last year, with Ming-Chi Kuo and Nikkei among those to have corroborated the plan. The component sharing claim builds on a string of downgrade reports over the past two weeks. The leaker first reported that Apple is implementing certain manufacturing downgrades to the iPhone 18 as a cost-cutting measure, before adding that display specifications and the chip will both be affected. Apple could be planning to tweak the name of the A-series chip used in the device to obscure the extent of the chip change.

Engineering Validation Testing of the iPhone 18 and iPhone 18e is said to be taking place simultaneously in June, which aligns with the idea that the two devices now share significant engineering overlap. Today, the iPhone 17 and iPhone 17e are meaningfully different devices: the standard model features a 6.3-inch display with ProMotion and up to 3,000 nits of peak outdoor brightness, the Dynamic Island, a five-core GPU, an Ultra Wide camera, and significantly better battery life. The iPhone 17e, by contrast, has a smaller 6.1-inch display, a notch rather than a Dynamic Island, no ProMotion, a four-core GPU, and no Ultra Wide camera.

If Apple is now sharing components between the iPhone 18 and iPhone 18e and reducing display and chip specifications on the standard model, many of those distinctions could shrink or disappear entirely in the next generation. The iPhone 18, iPhone 18e, and iPhone Air 2 are all expected to launch in spring 2027, with the iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max, and iPhone Ultra anticipated to be announced in the fall.

title: Ryzen 9 9950X3Dレビューガイドに偏りか？
summary:
• Ryzen 9 9950X3Dのレビューガイドにおいて、DRAMは285Kで8000、Ryzenシリーズで6000が使用された。
• 285Kの設定では、IntelのExtremeモードが選択され、200Sブーストが有効化された結果、NGUが2.6Gから3.2G、D2Dが2.1Gから3.2Gに増加した。
• レビューガイドの偏りについて、AMDが選んだレビュアーがガイドを厳守する必要はないとの意見が出ている。
content:
Ryzen 9 9950X3Dのレビューガイドに関する情報が公開された。このガイドによると、285KモデルではDRAM 8000が、RyzenシリーズではDRAM 6000が使用されていることが明らかになった。また、285Kの設定においては、Intelのデフォルト設定であるExtremeモードが選択され、200Sブーストが有効化された結果、NGUは2.6Gから3.2Gへ、D2Dは2.1Gから3.2Gへと数値が上昇したと報告されている。さらに、AMDが選んだレビュアーがレビューガイドを厳守する必要はないという意見も出されており、ガイド自体に偏りがある可能性が指摘されている。

中の人の本音 (JP)

え、マジで？レビューガイドがIntel寄りってどういうこと？AMDがIntelに忖度してるってこと？正直、ちょっと信じられないけど、まあ様子見安定かな。サンプル数が少ないのも気になるし、LeoWTechさんの言う通り、AMDファンボーイ扱いされるのも仕方ないのかも。
review_en: Wait, seriously? Intel-leaning review guide? Is AMD bowing to Intel? Honestly, a bit hard to believe, but let's wait and see. The small sample size is also concerning.
title_en: Bias Allegations Surface in Ryzen 9 9950X3D Review Guide?
summary_en:
• In the 9950X3D review guide, DRAM used for 285K was 8000 and for Ryzen series was 6000.
• For 285K, Intel's Extreme mode was chosen, and enabling 200S boost increased NGU from 2.6G to 3.2G and D2D from 2.1G to 3.2G.
• Concerns have been raised about bias in the review guide, suggesting AMD-selected reviewers aren't obligated to strictly follow it.
content_en:
Information regarding the Ryzen 9 9950X3D review guide has been released. The guide indicates that DRAM 8000 was used for the 285K model and DRAM 6000 for the Ryzen series. Furthermore, for the 285K configuration, Intel's default Extreme mode was selected, and enabling the 200S boost resulted in NGU increasing from 2.6G to 3.2G and D2D from 2.1G to 3.2G. Concerns have also been raised about potential bias in the guide, with some suggesting that AMD-selected reviewers are not obligated to strictly adhere to it.

Review (EN)

title: 20周年iPhone、エッジに一体化する触覚ボタンか
summary:
• 20周年記念iPhoneに、物理ボタンを廃止したソリッドステート触覚ボタンが搭載される可能性がある。
• このボタンは、手袋や濡れた手での操作、極端な温度下、ケース装着時でも機能するようにテスト済み。
• デバイスの電源がオフまたはバッテリー切れの場合でも機能する超低消費電力マイクロプロセッサを搭載予定。
content:
Appleは、20周年記念iPhoneにおいて、従来の物理ボタンを廃止し、デバイスのディスプレイの連続性を高めるソリッドステート触覚ボタンシステムをテストしていると、中国のリーカー「Instant Digital」が報告している。

同リーカーによると、このボタンは手袋や濡れた手での操作、極端な温度下、ケース装着時でも使用できるテストをすでに通過している。また、20周年記念iPhoneには、デバイスの電源がオフまたはバッテリーが切れていても、ソリッドステートボタンを機能させるための超低消費電力マイクロプロセッサが搭載されるという。

Instant Digitalは、2025年10月にも同様の情報を発信しており、Sideボタン、音量ボタン、アクションボタン、カメラコントロールボタンに触覚フィードバックが搭載される予定だと述べている。Appleは、デバイスの四辺すべてに沿ってディスプレイを湾曲させ、ボーダーレスな視覚体験を実現する作業を進めており、ソリッドステート触覚ボタンは、切り欠きやベゼルなしのガラススラブのようなデバイスを作成したいというAppleの意図に合致すると考えられる。

ただし、Appleによるソリッドステートボタンの採用は、これまで何度も噂されてきたが、実現には至っていない。2022年には、Appleが「Project Bongo」の一環として、ソリッドステートボタンをiPhone 15 Pro（2023年発売）に導入する計画があったという報告が複数あったが、最終段階で計画はキャンセルされた。その後、iPhone 16 Proへの搭載も噂されたが、無期限に延期されている。

Instant Digitalは、Weiboへの投稿で、2027年のデバイスに繰り返し噂されている他の機能についても言及している。具体的には、デュアルレイヤーOLEDパネル、ディスプレイ内蔵Face ID、ディスプレイ内蔵フロントカメラ、6,000mAhバッテリー、ディスプレイ内蔵オーディオ（イヤホン穴の廃止）、リバースワイヤレス充電、次世代Ceramic Shieldなどが挙げられている。ただし、これらの機能は、サプライチェーンの情報に基づいたものではなく、単なる希望的観測である可能性もある。

Instant Digitalは、Appleに関する噂に関して、一般的に高い信頼性を持っており、2023年のYellow iPhone 14の発売時期や、iPhone 15およびiPhone 15 Plusのフロストバックガラスなど、事前に正確な情報を提供してきた実績がある。20周年記念iPhoneは、2027年の秋に発売される見込み。

中の人の本音 (JP)

2027年かぁ…まだ先すぎじゃん。ソリッドステートボタンは正直、期待してるけど、過去に何度も頓挫してるから様子見安定かな。電源オフでも使えるってのはマジで便利そうだけど、バッテリー消費激しくない？デュアルレイヤーOLEDとかも気になるけど、結局は価格がネックになりそう。
review_en: 2027 is so far away. I'm honestly looking forward to the solid-state buttons, but it's a wait-and-see situation since it's been canceled so many times before.
title_en: 20th Anniversary iPhone Could Blend Haptic Buttons Into Curved Edges
summary_en:
• The 20th-anniversary iPhone may feature solid-state haptic buttons that replace physical buttons.
• These buttons have been tested for use with gloves, wet hands, extreme temperatures, and with a case on.
• The device is expected to include an ultra-low energy microprocessor allowing the buttons to function even when powered off or with a depleted battery.
content_en:
Apple is testing a solid-state haptic button system for the 20th-anniversary iPhone to replace traditional physical buttons and enhance the continuity of the device's display, according to Chinese leaker "Instant Digital.".

According to the leaker, the buttons have already passed tests for use when wearing gloves or having wet hands, in extreme temperatures, and when the phone has a case on. The 20th-anniversary iPhone will also be equipped with an ultra-low energy microprocessor allowing the solid-state buttons to remain functional even when the handset is powered off or the battery has run out.

Instant Digital previously made the same claim in October 2025, stating that haptic feedback will be included for the Side button, volume buttons, Action button, and Camera Control button. Apple is reportedly working on a display that curves down around all four edges of the device for a borderless visual experience - and solid-state haptic buttons could help in Apple's apparent desire to create a device that looks like a slab of glass with no cutouts and no bezels.

However, Apple's adoption of solid-state buttons has been repeatedly rumored for an iPhone, but with nothing to show for it. Back in 2022, several reports suggested Apple intended to bring solid-state buttons to the iPhone 15 Pro in 2023 as part of "Project Bongo." However, the plan was reportedly canceled at a late stage. They were then rumored to come to the iPhone 16 Pro, before being shelved indefinitely.

In the same Weibo post, the leaker also mentioned other features that have been repeatedly rumored for the 2027 device, such as a dual-layer OLED panel, under-display Face ID, and an under-display front-facing camera. They also mentioned a 6,000mAh battery, under-display audio (eliminating the earpiece slit), reverse wireless charging, and a next-generation Ceramic Shield - although it's unclear whether these last few items are more of a wish list of features rather than being based on new supply chain information.

Instant Digital has a generally good track record for Apple rumors and has provided some accurate information ahead of time, such as the imminent launch of 2023's Yellow iPhone 14, as well as the frosted back glass of the iPhone 15 and iPhone 15 Plus. The 20th anniversary iPhone will presumably come out in the fall of 2027.

Review (EN)

2027 is so far away. I'm honestly looking forward to the solid-state buttons, but it's a wait-and-see situation since it's been canceled so many times before.

title: OpenAI、2027年にもAIエージェント搭載スマホを量産か
summary:

• 2027年と2028年の合計で約3,000万台の出荷が予測されている。
content:
郭明錤氏の情報によると、OpenAIが初のAIエージェント搭載スマホの開発を加速させている可能性がある。目標は最速で2027年第1四半期に量産を開始することであり、その背景には年末のIPOに向けたポジティブなストーリー作りや、AIエージェント搭載スマホの競争激化などが考えられる。

同スマホのプロセッサは、聯発科技（MediaTek）が独占的に供給する可能性が高く、天璣9600をベースとしたカスタムバージョンが採用される予定。製造は台積電のN2Pプロセスで2026年後半に行われる見込みだ。また、ISP（画像信号処理）の強化により、高ダイナミックレンジ出力が可能となり、現実世界の視覚認識能力の向上が期待される。

その他の主要な仕様としては、デュアルNPU（ニューラル・プロセッシング・ユニット）によるAI処理能力の階層化、LPDDR6とUFS 5.0によるメモリボトルネックの緩和、pKVMとインラインハッシュによるセキュリティ強化などが挙げられる。開発が順調に進めば、2027年と2028年の2年間で合計約3,000万台の出荷が見込まれている。

中の人の本音 (JP)

OpenAIがスマホ作るってマジ！？AIエージェント搭載とか、ぶっちゃけどんな感じになるか想像つかないけど、めっちゃ楽しみ。MediaTekのチップ搭載でTSMCのN2Pプロセスって、結構ガチっぽいね。3000万台出荷ってのも、かなりデカい数字だなぁ。様子見安定だけど、個人的には期待大！

title_en: OpenAI to Mass Produce AI Agent Phone as Early as 2027?
summary_en:
• It has been revealed that OpenAI is accelerating the development of its first AI agent-powered smartphone.
• The smartphone is expected to be equipped with a custom version of the Dimensity 9600 processor and manufactured by TSMC's N2P process in the second half of 2026.
• Approximately 30 million units are forecast to be shipped in total in 2027 and 2028.
content_en:
According to Ming-Chi Kuo, OpenAI is potentially accelerating the development of its first AI agent-powered smartphone. The target is to start mass production as early as the first quarter of 2027, with the background including positive storytelling for the year-end IPO and the intensifying competition for AI agent-powered smartphones.

The smartphone's processor is likely to be exclusively supplied by MediaTek, and a custom version based on the Dimensity 9600 is planned to be adopted. Manufacturing is expected to take place in the second half of 2026 using TSMC's N2P process. In addition, the enhancement of the ISP (Image Signal Processor) will enable high dynamic range output, which is expected to improve visual perception in the real world.

Other key specifications include hierarchical AI processing power with a dual NPU (Neural Processing Unit), alleviation of memory bottlenecks with LPDDR6 and UFS 5.0, and security enhancement with pKVM and inline hashing. title: Team Group、ELITE PLUS DDR5/ELITE DDR5 8000MT/sモデルを発表
summary:

• Amazon North Americaで近日中に販売開始予定。
content:
Team Group Inc.は、ELITE PLUS DDR5およびELITE DDR5デスクトップメモリモジュールの新モデルを発表した。両製品は、最大8000 MT/sの速度を実現し、1.1 Vで動作、CL56-56-56-128のタイミングでJEDEC規格に準拠していることが明らかになった。高周波動作の需要増加に対応するため設計されており、パフォーマンス要件を満たすだけでなく、全体的なシステムパフォーマンスとコンピューティング体験を向上させると報告されている。両製品は、北米のAmazonで近日中に販売開始予定である。

ELITE PLUS DDR5 8000 MT/sとELITE DDR5 8000 MT/sは、高周波かつ低消費電力のデスクトップメモリモジュールとして設計されている。周波数アップグレードにより、学習やエンターテイメントを含む様々なデスクトップ用途をサポートする。1.1 Vで動作することで、消費電力を効果的に削減し、コンピュータの寿命を延ばす。また、DDR5 Same-Bank Refresh技術と最適化されたICアーキテクチャを搭載し、マルチタスク環境下でのスムーズな動作を維持し、全体的なシステム効率を向上させる。

中の人の本音 (JP)

Team Groupから新しいDDR5メモリが出たみたいですね。8000MT/sってのは速い！CL56-56-56-128も悪くないラインナップかな。Amazonで買えるようになるの待ってみます。正直、価格がどうなるか様子見安定ですけどね…

title: DDR6メモリ開発、2028年出荷目標で加速
summary:
• SK hynix、Samsung、Micronなどの主要メモリメーカーがDDR6の開発を開始。
• DDR6は8,800 MT/sから17,600 MT/sのデータ転送速度を目指す。
• サーバー向けプラットフォームが先行し、その後ハイエンドノートPCへの展開が見込まれる。
content:
次世代のDDR6メモリが、デスクトップおよびサーバー向けに2028年の商用出荷を目指して開発が進められていることが明らかになった。The Elecの報道によると、SK hynix、Samsung、Micronなどの主要メモリメーカーは、JEDECと協力して新たな規格の確立に取り組んでいる。これらのメーカーは、2024年からJEDECのDDR6ドラフトにアクセスできるようになったと報告されているが、最終的な電圧範囲、信号使用、電力エンベロープ、ピン配置設計などの具体的な仕様はまだ決定されていない。しかし、メーカーが標準化開発を加速させているため、今後変更される見込みである。

昨年、主要プレイヤーはプロトタイプ段階を過ぎ、厳格な検証サイクルに入ったと報告されている。最も注目すべき点は、8,800 MT/sの指定されたスループットで、驚異的な17,600 MT/sまでスケールアップする計画である。これは、今日のDDR5の天井をほぼ2倍にするものである。この増加は、DDR6の4×24-BITサブチャネルアーキテクチャによって推進されており、信号整合性に対するまったく新しいアプローチが必要となる。また、DDR5の現在の2x32-BITサブチャネル構造とも異なる。より高い速度でのDIMMフォームファクタが直面する物理的な制限を克服するために、業界はCAMM2技術に期待している。初期の兆候は、サーバープラットフォームが変化を主導し、製造が拡大するとともにハイエンドノートPCがそれに続くことを示唆している。

中の人の本音 (JP)

DDR6、2028年かぁ…まだ先の話だけど、17,600 MT/sってマジかよ！DDR5もまだ全然使い切れてないのに、次が来るの早すぎない？サーバー先行は当然として、ゲーミングPCにも早く来てほしいけど、価格がネックになりそう。様子見安定かな。
review_en: DDR6 in 2028... Still a ways off, but 17,600 MT/s is insane! Waiting to see.
title_en: DDR6 Memory Development Accelerates with 2028 Shipment Target
summary_en:
• Major memory manufacturers such as SK hynix, Samsung, and Micron have begun developing DDR6.
• DDR6 aims for data transfer rates from 8,800 MT/s to 17,600 MT/s.
• Server platforms are expected to lead the adoption, followed by high-end notebooks.
content_en:
Development of the next-generation Double Data Rate 6 (DDR6) memory is progressing rapidly, aiming for commercial shipments in 2028 for desktops and servers. According to The Elec, major memory manufacturers such as SK hynix, Samsung, and Micron are working with JEDEC to establish a new standard. These manufacturers reportedly gained access to JEDEC's first DDR6 draft as early as 2024, but concrete specifications such as finalized voltage ranges, signal usage, power envelopes, and pinout design are still lacking. However, these are expected to change as manufacturers are now accelerating standard development.

Last year, it was reported that the major players mentioned above had already moved past the prototype stages and embarked on rigorous validation cycles. Perhaps the most interesting aspect is the designated throughput of 8,800 MT/s, with plans to scale up to a staggering 17,600 MT/s, nearly doubling the ceiling of today's DDR5. This increase is driven by DDR6's 4×24-BIT sub-channel architecture, which requires entirely new approaches to signal integrity. It also differs from DDR5's current 2x32-BIT sub-channel structure. To overcome the physical limits faced by DIMM form factors at higher speeds, the industry is betting on CAMM2 technology. Early indications suggest that server platforms will lead the change, with high-end notebooks following once manufacturing ramps up.

Review (EN)

DDR6 in 2028... Still a ways off, but 17,600 MT/s is insane! Waiting to see.

title: Apple、iOS 26.5とiPadOS 26.5のリリース候補を開発者に配布
summary:
• AppleがiOS 26.5とiPadOS 26.5のリリース候補を開発者に配布した。
• iOS 26.5とiPadOS 26.5には新しいSiri機能は含まれていない。
• EUでは、サードパーティ製ウェアラブル向けの近接ペアリングなどがテストされている。
content:
Appleは本日、開発者向けに、今後のiOS 26.5およびiPadOS 26.5アップデートのリリース候補版を配布したと報告されている。今回のソフトウェアは、Appleが第4のベータ版をリリースしてから1週間後に提供された。

登録された開発者は、iPhoneまたはiPadの設定アプリの「一般」セクションから「ソフトウェアアップデート」を選択することで、ベータ版をダウンロードできる。

iOS 26.5とiPadOS 26.5には新しいSiri機能は含まれておらず、SiriのアップデートはiOS 27まで持ち越される可能性が示唆されている。Mapsアプリには、トレンドや最近の検索に基づいて近くの場所を推奨する「Suggested Places」機能が追加されており、AppleはApple Mapsアプリへの広告導入の準備を進めている。

Appleは、iPhoneとAndroidユーザー間のRCSメッセージのエンドツーエンド暗号化（E2EE）のテストを継続している。この機能はiOS 26.4ベータ版に含まれていたが、正式リリース前に削除された。

今年のPride Apple Watchバンドに合わせた新しいPride壁紙が追加されている。

欧州連合（EU）では、Appleは、イヤホンやスマートウォッチなどのサードパーティ製ウェアラブル向けの近接ペアリング、通知転送、Live Activitiesをテストしている。この機能により、サードパーティ製ウェアラブルはApple WatchやAirPodsと同等の機能を備えることができるようになる。

iOS 26.5の新機能の詳細については、iOS 26.5ベータ機能ガイドを参照できる。iOS 26.5は来週発売される可能性が高い。

中の人の本音 (JP)

リリース候補かー。Siri機能は27まで待つのか。マップの広告はちょっと微妙だけど、RCSのE2EEはマジで来てほしい！EUのウェアラブル対応も面白そう。来週の正式版に期待！
review_en: RC is out! No Siri features till iOS 27. Ads in Maps are kinda sus, but RCS E2EE is a must! EU wearable support looks cool. Looking forward to the final release!
title_en: Apple Seeds iOS 26.5 and iPadOS 26.5 Release Candidates to Developers
summary_en:
• Apple has seeded release candidate versions of iOS 26.5 and iPadOS 26.5 to developers.
• iOS 26.5 and iPadOS 26.5 do not include new Siri capabilities.
• In the EU, proximity pairing for third-party wearables is being tested.
content_en:
Apple today seeded the release candidate versions of upcoming iOS 26.5 and iPadOS 26.5 updates to developers for testing purposes, with the software coming a week after Apple released the fourth betas.

Registered developers can download the betas from the Settings app on the iPhone or iPad by going to the General section and selecting Software Update.

iOS 26.5 and iPadOS 26.5 do not include new Siri capabilities, suggesting any ‌Siri‌ updates are being held until iOS 27. The Maps app has a Suggested Places feature for recommending locations to visit nearby based on trends and recent searches, plus Apple is laying the groundwork for ads in the Apple Maps app.

Apple is continuing to test end-to-end encryption (E2EE) for RCS messages between iPhone and Android users. Apple included the feature in the iOS 26.4 beta, but removed it before the update launched to the public.

There is a new Pride wallpaper to go along with the Pride Apple Watch band for this year.

In the European Union, Apple is testing proximity pairing, notification forwarding, and Live Activities for third-party wearables like earbuds and smartwatches. The functionality will allow third-party wearables to have many of the same features as the Apple Watch and AirPods.

More detail on what's new in iOS 26.5 can be found in our iOS 26.5 beta features guide. iOS 26.5 is likely to see a launch next week.

Review (EN)

RC is out! No Siri features till iOS 27. Ads in Maps are kinda sus, but RCS E2EE is a must! EU wearable support looks cool. Looking forward to the final release!
